title: Assessment of implant stability following sinus lift procedures with different grafting materials. Jelušić D
authors: Puhar I, Plančak D. Acta Stomatol Croat. 2014 Mar;48(1):25-32. doi: 10.15644/asc48/1/3.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss maxresorb / maxresorb inject (biphasic CaP) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “This study demonstrated that the implant stability is comparable among implants placed in the posterior maxilla regardless of sinus lift and grafting procedure. Implants placed in the grafted posterior maxilla can be predictably loaded as the implants placed in a non -grafted, pristine maxilla. 06/2023” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
